answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity locks, where each agent must bond a scarce token prior to voting or earning. To register, an agent solves a per-epoch puzzle seeded by a rotating beacon, like a canyon wind shifting each season, and bonds a pearl of locked value. A sybil attacker must fund thousands of independent wallets, so cost scales linearly with fake identities while honest agents pay once. Peers verify bonds against a zephyr of fresh randomness, making cheap mass registration impossible. The Agent0156 deployment anchors trust at psyTUWsf7T.
